description:
IT-Specialist for Manufacturing Data Analysis  
 The IT-Specialist for Manufacturing Data Analysis plays a key role in the field of Yield Enhancement of XYZ’s brand new technology. The main responsibilities of this role are setup and maintenance of IT applications for product grading during frontend processing.
 The role will also require involvement in yield trend monitoring using advanced data analysis methodologies and software. The role supports the Yield Enhancement team in all yield and defect density related tasks.
 The role will be based in ABC. However occasional business travel may also be required.
 Key areas of responsibilities  
 Definition, design, test, implementation and maintenance of IT applications for manufacturing data acquisition and analysis
 Database structure and algorithms for product grading
 Modification and development of IT solutions to support product diversity
 Support and sustaining of manufacturing IT systems
 Consultancy and training to IT application users, creation of manuals and training materials
 Close collaboration with yield enhancement engineers in the field of data correlation of yield and quality issues down to failure root cause 
 Key competencies  
 Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Sciences or a related discipline
 Excellent knowledge in SQL and ORACLE DBMS
 Excellent Java programming skills
 Basic programming skills in HTML, PHP, JavaScript, XML, WebServices, Shell
 Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows Server
 Good knowledge in manufacturing IT systems (MDA, MES, Line Works SPACE)
 Good knowledge in data analysis/correlation (experienced user of data mining and analysis tools like Spot fire, Cornerstone, JMP or Minitab)
 Team player with good interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels
 Good problem-solving skills and the ability to approach process issues in a structured manner under pressure and with tight deadlines
 Organizational skills and continuous improvement approach
 Fluent in English
 Write Sql queries to move from one side to another
 SQL Reporting Services
 Someone who’s a consultant and throw in their two cents on how to get the job done
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 2-3 months
